verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only the underlying foundation: NVIDIA's CUDA Toolkit, fifth-gen Tensor Cores with BF16/FP16/FP8/FP4 deep-learning precision, and independent CUDA compute benchmarks plus 'potent AI performance' on the 5090. Nothing ties PyTorch or other ML frameworks to this GPU through official builds or support matrices. Missing for 10: any evidence of official PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX builds supporting the RTX 5090 (Blackwell), a documented framework or CUDA compute-capability support matrix, and hands-on reports of ML frameworks running on the card.
